description: 107年度1719條土石流潛勢溪流圖(TWD97 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] (series on Taiwan Government Open Data Platform) is a series of datasets listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 提供107年度1719條土石流潛勢溪流圖(TWD97)shp下載檔案，內容包含ID(編號)、Debrisno(土石流潛勢溪流編號)、County01(縣市)、Town01(鄉鎮)、Vill01(村里)、County02(次要經過縣市)、Town02(次要經過鄉鎮)、Vill02(次要經過村里)、Name(名稱)、Mark(地標)、Road... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal lists 26 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2025-12-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
